priority.description: Sets the alarm priority and notification behavior.

pickup_setpoint.description: Threshold that causes the alarm to pick up. Over alarms trigger above this value; under alarms trigger below it.

pickup_time_delay.description: Time the signal must remain beyond the pickup setpoint before the alarm becomes active.

dropout_setpoint.description: Threshold that causes the alarm to drop out. Over alarms clear below this value; under alarms clear above it.

dropout_time_delay.description: Time the signal must remain beyond the dropout setpoint before the alarm clears.

pickup_pf_lead_lag.description: Defines the PF quadrant used for the pickup setpoint. Lead = leading PF, Lag = lagging PF.

dropout_pf_lead_lag.description: Defines the PF quadrant used for the dropout setpoint.

select_digital_output.description: Selects the digital output(s) activated when the alarm is active.
